authority.revision: Fresh complete design after F8R3 structural accounting failure. Frozen F8R3 artifacts are design evidence only;no code,output,seed,execution or status is reused.

claim.estimand: Equal-weight mean across exactly eight fixed roots of paired root-actor payoff difference:ensemble-root minus canonical-H11-root,both followed by common H11-P256 for at most8 post-root player actions and then passive exact closure.
claim.E1_gate: Unrounded one-sided fixed-root Welch-Satterthwaite95% LCB>=+0.20 big blinds per reached root.
forbidden_claims: Slumbot improvement or any strength level
claim.quick5k: Not due because no deployable checkpoint or official policy changes.

rng_probability_lanes.rng: Fresh identity-keyed SHA256 counter RNG with disjoint census,solver,E0,E1 domains;big-endian first8;open01=(u64+0.5)/2^64;bounded integer rejection sampling;retain raw keys.
rng_probability_lanes.probability: One CPU-f64 legal-logit routine:copy exact float32 logits,mask legal slots,subtract legal max,exp,divide float64 sum,illegal mass0,slot-order CDF,force final legal CDF1,sample first CDF strictly greater than open01.
rng_probability_lanes.canonical_H11: Fixed contiguous batch256 chunks;only duplicate final real row for padding and discard padding.
rng_probability_lanes.H11_P256: Permanent512 lanes,two batch256 calls,no compaction,physical=(logical+73*iteration) mod512;profile,holes,actions,outcome excluded from mapping.
rng_probability_lanes.balance: Each logical lane occupies every physical position exactly4 times across2,048 solver iterations.
rng_probability_lanes.evaluation_pairing: Same tape has same source/opponent holes,sealed remaining deck,root uniform,ordinal uniforms and lane in separate profile passes.

roots_and_belief.selection: Preassign cell per hand;smallest public-only eligible digest within and across hands;exactly one root/cell and eight distinct source hands;no replacement.
roots_and_belief.eligibility: Live exact-cent public state,at least2 legal nonnull V5.5 slots,complete history,no seventh same-street action. Hidden cards,outcome,reward,probabilities and solver output excluded.
roots_and_belief.joint_mu: Uniform ordered disjoint-hole prior times chronological canonical-H11 observed-action likelihoods;CPU-f64 logsumexp;full joint only.
roots_and_belief.source_hole: Freeze after public selection;positive marginal required;never affects selection or alternative-hole likelihood.

solver.proposal: rho=1/8;nu=1[source-hole]*mu/m_star;q=(1-rho)*mu+rho*nu;sample full q;apply w=mu/q exactly once;full support;w<=8/7.
solver.update: Freeze sigma,run both traversers,enumerate traverser legal actions,collect both deltas,then simultaneously clip cumulative regrets at0.
solver.root_average: Before update S+=t*sigma,D=2048*2049/2=2098176;candidate equal average of replica endpoints.

hybrid_continuation.trigger: Enter passive mode before ninth P256 decision or before an H11 observation needing seventh same-street action.
hybrid_continuation.passive: No network query. Facing wager call min(to_call,stack);otherwise check;never fold,bet or raise. Use presealed uniform remaining-deck permutation;run out all-ins,otherwise check through;resolve wager before street advance;refund excess;terminate with exact-cent zero-sum payoff.
hybrid_continuation.evidence: Record trigger CAP8/HISTORY_OVERFLOW,all passive actions/chance,legality,commitments,terminal,payoff and trace hash.

E0.deal: Fix source actor hole;sample opponent directly from mu(.|source),never q;future cards from sealed deck.
E0.candidate: Ensemble=.5*(A+B) fixed before E0 and never selected with E0.
E0.gates: A point uplift>0;B point uplift>0;ensemble analytic LCB>0;mean JS<=.10;root-p95 JS<=.25;top-slot agreement>=.50;all integrity/fallback/evidence gates.

E1.sealed: Manifest bytes/SHA exist before solver and are inaccessible to solver/E0.
E1.open: Fresh process binds candidate,A/B,E0 raw hashes and unopened E1 SHA.
E1.raw: Create-new per-profile and paired rows bind identity,root,tape,holes,deck hash,root slot,all ordinal RNG hashes,lane,calls,fallback/passive trace,terminal payoff cents,difference cents/bb.

analytic_inference.root_stats: Fixed root order,binary64 mean and sample variance ddof=1.
analytic_inference.degenerate: If V exactly0 and all finite/integrity gates pass,set df=+inf,LCB=theta;otherwise denominator/df finite positive.
analytic_inference.scope: Fixed strata,never resample roots;candidate fixed;solver randomness excluded;one E1 primary.

resource_admission.position: After implementation and independent no-model implementation-audit PASS;before science.
resource_admission.rates: Use only frozen F8R1C1 eight-block minima/fixed costs;no fresh performance probe.

total_padding_envelope.note: One total envelope. Passive and chance work are already included and must not be added again. Extra capacity is resource-only and cannot create scientific rows.

resource_admission.PASS: Authorizes exactly one bounded F8R4 scientific execution.

audit_abort_judgment.preimplementation: Independently instantiate identity,input hashes,path absence,all work/passive/resource/inference formulas and zero counts.
audit_abort_judgment.implementation: Independent no-model exact-cent,RNG,probability,tiny-MCCFR+,lane,passive legality/termination,inference,E0/E1 isolation and exact-count oracles.
audit_abort_judgment.result: Independent raw rehash and recomputation of payoff,difference,counts,fallback denominators,means,variances,df,t-critical,LCB,resource and every gate.
audit_abort_judgment.outputs: Create-new only;no overwrite,latest pointer,reconstruction or mutation.
audit_abort_judgment.route_effect: PASS permits only separately registered broader teacher work;NONPASS reranks and alone does not exhaust the family.
